categories.name: Person
categories.definition: An individual human being, including politicians, athletes, artists, academics, and other public figures.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A motion picture or cinematic work, including feature films, documentaries, and silent movies.

categories.name: Album
categories.definition: A collection of audio recordings, such as a music album, soundtrack, or compilation, typically released as a single item.

categories.name: Plant
categories.definition: A living organism belonging to the kingdom Plantae, including species of trees, shrubs, flowering plants, grasses, and mosses.

categories.name: Village
categories.definition: A small community or settlement in a rural area, typically smaller than a town.

categories.name: Watercraft
categories.definition: A vehicle used for navigation on water, including ships, boats, and submarines.

categories.name: Building
categories.definition: A man-made structure with a roof and walls, such as a house, church, school, or historic building.

categories.name: Journal
categories.definition: A periodical academic or professional publication containing articles and research findings.

categories.name: Aircraft
categories.definition: A vehicle capable of atmospheric flight, including airplanes, helicopters, and gliders.

categories.name: River
categories.definition: A large natural stream of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

categories.name: Animal
categories.definition: A living organism belonging to the kingdom Animalia, including mammals, birds, reptiles, insects, and marine life.

categories.name: Book
categories.definition: A written or printed work consisting of pages bound together, including novels, biographies, and non-fiction.

categories.name: Company
categories.definition: A business organization that produces goods or provides services.

categories.name: School
categories.definition: An educational institution where students are taught, including primary, secondary, and higher education schools.

categories.name: Locomotive
categories.definition: A powered rail vehicle used for pulling trains.

categories.name: Mountain
categories.definition: A large natural elevation of the earth's surface rising abruptly from the surrounding level.

categories.name: Lake
categories.definition: A large body of water surrounded by land.

categories.name: Glacier
categories.definition: A slowly moving mass of ice formed by accumulated snow on mountains or near the poles.

categories.name: Crater
categories.definition: A large bowl-shaped cavity in the ground or on the surface of a planet or moon.

categories.name: Play
categories.definition: A dramatic work for the stage or to be read.

categories.name: Comic Book
categories.definition: A publication consisting of comic art in the form of sequential juxtaposed panels that represent individual scenes.

categories.name: Mountain Range
categories.definition: A chain of mountains bordered by highlands or separated from other mountains by passes or valleys.

categories.name: Film Character
categories.definition: A fictional persona appearing in a motion picture.

categories.name: Reservoir
categories.definition: A large natural or artificial lake used as a source of water supply.

categories.name: Newspaper
categories.definition: A printed publication containing news, articles, advertisements, and other information.

categories.name: Film Series
categories.definition: A collection of related films that share the same fictional universe or characters.

categories.name: Plant Genus
categories.definition: A taxonomic rank used in biological classification of living organisms which is below family and above species.

categories.name: Animal Genus
categories.definition: A taxonomic rank used in biological classification of living organisms which is below family and above species.

categories.name: Plant Family
categories.definition: A taxonomic rank used in biological classification of living organisms which is below order and above genus.

categories.name: Vehicle Class
categories.definition: A specific design or model type of vehicle, typically used for military or transportation purposes.

categories.name: University
categories.definition: A high-level educational institution in which students study for degrees and academic research is done.

categories.name: Novel
categories.definition: A fictitious prose narrative of book length, typically representing character and action with some degree of realism.

categories.name: Automobile
categories.definition: A road vehicle, typically with four wheels, powered by an internal combustion engine and able to carry a small number of people.

categories.name: EP
categories.definition: A musical recording that contains more tracks than a single but fewer than an album.

categories.name: Compilation Album
categories.definition: An album consisting of tracks by one or more artists, often previously released material.

categories.name: Soundtrack
categories.definition: The recorded sound from a motion picture or television program.

categories.name: Concept Album
categories.definition: An album where all the songs contribute to a single overall theme or story.

categories.name: Film Director
categories.definition: A person who directs the making of a film.

categories.name: Actor
categories.definition: A person whose profession is acting on the stage, in movies, or on television.

categories.name: Politician
categories.definition: A person who is professionally involved in politics, especially as a holder of or a candidate for an elected office.

categories.name: Athlete
categories.definition: A person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

categories.name: Musician
categories.definition: A person who plays a musical instrument, especially as a profession, or is musically talented.

categories.name: Writer
categories.definition: A person who has written a particular text or who writes as an occupation.

categories.name: Painter
categories.definition: An artist who paints pictures.

categories.name: Academic

categories.name: Religious Figure

categories.name: Military Unit

categories.name: Political Jurisdiction

categories.name: Extinct Plant Genus

categories.definition: A taxonomic rank below class and above order.

categories.name: Monastic House

categories.name: Film Production Company

categories.name: Museum Complex

categories.name: Chateau

categories.name: Natural Site

categories.name: Hamlet

categories.name: Locomotive Class
